system.description: Your body radiates a soft but apparent heat, that increases in intensity to match opposing sources of heat that would harm you, making you more tolerant of extreme circumstances. You gain resistance to fire damage and make checks to resist harmful effects from extreme heat at advantage. Starting at 7th level, you can attempt to siphon the scorching heat from an allied creature, treating their burns. As a bonus action, while you are within 15 feet of an allied creature that has ranks of Burn, you can attempt an ability check using your highest jutsu ability modifier vs the DC to end the Burned condition (Either the condition or the Save DC, whichever is lower). Beginning at 11th level, you gain immunity to the Burned condition and checks you make to end another creatures burned condition gain a rank of Master to the result. Beginning at 15th level, checks you make to end another creatures burned condition gain 2 ranks of Mastery to the result.
